# Opinel

> Opinel is a French cutlery brand specializing in pocket knives, kitchen knives, and table cutlery with over 130 years of heritage from the French Alps.

Founded in 1890 in Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne, Opinel offers a comprehensive range of knives from traditional pocket knives to professional restaurant cutlery, with customization and corporate gifting services available across multiple European languages.

## Key Topics

- Pocket knives
- Kitchen knives
- Carbon steel blades
- Stainless steel blades
- Personalization & laser engraving
- Limited editions
- Table knives
- Outdoor knives
- Corporate gifts
- French heritage
- N°08 & N°07 models
- Traditional designs
- Luxury collections
- Children's knives
- Knife accessories

## Product Collections

- [Pocket Knives](https://www.opinel.com/fr/couteaux-poche): Complete collection of pocket knives made in French Alps since 1890
- [Traditional Pocket Knives](https://www.opinel.com/fr/couteaux-poche/tradition): Classic Opinel pocket knives with various woods and timeless designs
- [Stainless Steel Blade Pocket Knives](https://www.opinel.com/fr/couteaux-poche/lame-inox): Durable stainless steel pocket knives ideal for outdoor activities
- [Carbon Steel Blade Pocket Knives](https://www.opinel.com/fr/couteaux-poche/lame-carbone): High-performance carbon steel knives with exceptional sharpness
- [Luxury Pocket Knives](https://www.opinel.com/fr/couteaux-poche/collection-luxe): Premium pocket knives featuring luxury wood handles and fine craftsmanship
- [Decorated Handles](https://www.opinel.com/fr/couteaux-poche/manches-decores): Pocket knives with engraved, tamographed, and sublimated decorative handles
- [Colored Pocket Knives](https://www.opinel.com/fr/couteaux-poche/manche-couleurs): Pocket knives available in vibrant and pastel color options
- [New Releases](https://www.opinel.com/fr/nouveautes): Latest knife collections and newly launched products

## Brand & Heritage

- [Opinel Museum](https://www.opinel.com/fr/le-musee-opinel): Museum in Saint-Jean-de-Maurienne showcasing Opinel's 130+ year brand history
- [Limited Editions & Collaborations](https://www.opinel.com/fr/la-marque/collaborations-et-series-limitees): Exclusive limited edition knives and brand collaborations with commemorative designs

## Professional & Corporate Solutions

- [Restaurant & Professional Knives](https://www.opinel.com/fr/offres-entreprises/restaurateurs): Professional table knives and cutlery designed for restaurant and catering businesses
- [Corporate Gifts & Promotional Knives](https://www.opinel.com/fr/offres-entreprises/cadeaux-daffaires): Customizable promotional knives and corporate gift solutions with personalization options
